pieces.name: Japanese shrine pavilion
pieces.note: indoor shrine pavilion for double-height rooms: four vermilion-lacquered pillars on black bases, tie and head beams, carved bracket sets, an irimoya hip-and-gable kawara roof with a soft sori curve, upturned corners, a black kayaoi eave board over exposed rafters and a slatted gable, on a walnut plank deck over a granite plinth with a front step; inside a mirror altar with sakaki vases, a paper andon, a suzu bell with its rope in front of the offering box, and a hidden purple LED cove under the head beams. About 3.2 m square and 3.8 m tall: needs at least 3.9 m clear headroom (double-height rooms only); deck 0.20 m up, 2.05 m clear under the tie beams, 2.2 m under the head beams. Roof sections shatter into strips when the head frame goes; about 29k triangles intact (over the 15k guideline: a room-sized hero piece)
